I picked NoSQL because it sounded scalable. Six months later I desperately missed joins.

SQL vs NoSQL isn't a personality test — it's a data-model and query-shape decision.

What this post covers:

• When relational DBs still win at scale
• Replication: leader-follower and read replicas
• Sharding — and why it makes every query harder
• Indexing trade-offs you feel in production

The hype cuts both ways. This is the framing I use before picking a datastore.
